faq.moveProject: How to Move a Repository to Another Namespace in GitLab

steps.1: Log in to GitLab: Open your GitLab instance and log in to your account.
steps.2: Navigate to the Project: Go to the project you want to move.
steps.3: Go to Project Settings: In the left sidebar of your project, click on Settings, then General to open the general settings of the project.
steps.4: Expand the 'Advanced' Section: Scroll down to find the Advanced section, and click on it to expand the options.
steps.5: Change Namespace: In the Advanced section, you should see a field called 'Transfer project'. Click on the 'Transfer project' button.
steps.6: Choose the New Namespace: A dialog will pop up asking you to select the target namespace. You can select either a Group or another user namespace. Select the appropriate namespace (auto-cicd or a subgroup) and click Transfer project.
steps.7: Confirmation: GitLab will ask you to confirm the move. Once confirmed, the repository will be transferred to the new namespace.
